commands.label: corrected

assumptions.assumption: Changing represented register banks is not acknowledgment of an unrelated deferred exit.
assumptions.basis: Existing native HLT/I/O preservation and run_native deferred-delivery behavior.
assumptions.dependent_result: Remove deferred-exit loss from public overlays.
assumptions.stress_test: Six native direct-exit kinds; userspace and kernel IRQ-chip graphs;1/2/4 CPUs; actual register modification and repeated delivery.
assumptions.falsification_probe: A deferred event vanishes, changes, or permits guest execution before delivery.
assumptions.status: exclusive native control confirmed; managed and broad gates pending

bounded_findings.finding: This does not serialize deferred exits or close native kernel controller/timer checkpoints. Complete producer remains required.
